review_notes: Thirty existing definitions across nineteen source files: use the integer info_slot view for numeric choices, counters, damage and life values in twenty-four definitions; keep actual callback comparisons on info_slot_fn. No card_instance_t layout changes.

Targeted original DWARF and native disassembly confirm integer amount/amount/x roles in Taigam, Exponential Growth and Imbraham and DWORD increment/storage in Pyric Salamander. Four definition rows carry native input hashes, DIE/local type evidence and disassembly receipts.

Restore readable Odyssey locals, Flame Burst routing and both Verdant Succession paths. Retain callback order, cached/live context and opaque chooser calls. Replace the complete 151-byte Breath of Dreams clearing loop with memset.

Two alpha-only definition edits receive exact token checks. Structured changes receive focused review and one combined incremental build. Broad historical audits, inventories, gameplay tests and reccmp refresh deferred. Preserve staged index.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
